name: Correctability vs Irreversibility v142
oracle_policy: true recovery outcome and hidden error source used only for audit; policy observes severity, irreversibility proxy, correctability estimate, uncertainty and sensitivity

policies.correctability_aware: probe value weighted by expected loss of future correction capacity
policies.irreversibility_only: probe threshold based on irreversibility only
policies.joint_criticality: uses harm severity + irreversibility + correctability + uncertainty spillover
policies.severity_only: probe threshold based on immediate harm severity only

status: synthetic test separating immediate severity from future correctability
